title: Introduce cohorted intake sampler and annotated release bundler
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a cohort-driven sampling component for model intake and a release bundler that emits annotated changelog snippets, provenance hashes, and cohort coverage metrics. Improves onboarding visibility and reduces noisy release notes for large model updates.
description: Motivation: onboarding churn for large model uploads produced long, noisy changelogs that were hard for reviewers to triage. This PR implements a cohort-aware intake sampler that selects representative probes per model variant and a release bundler that packages compact annotated changelog snippets plus provenance and cohort-coverage metrics. Implementation: 1) ingest/cohort_sampler: deterministic cohort selection seeded by model manifest fingerprint; supports weighted cohorts, stratified sampling across datasets and input lengths, and optional sampling profiles passed from the CLI or CI. 2) bundler/release_bundler: consumes sampler output, computes a canonical provenance hash for the intake bundle, synthesizes concise changelog fragments prioritized by regression score and coverage delta, and emits a compact release bundle artifact (ndjson + metadata.json). 3) CLI: onboardctl additions to preview cohort composition and produce a dry-run changelog preview. 4) tests and docs: unit tests for sampler determinism and coverage heuristics, integration test for bundler end-to-end, and docs describing how to interpret cohort coverage and attach release snippets to model versions. Checklist: - [x] design doc approved (ENG-2046) - [x] sampler core implementation - [x] bundler compact changelog synthesis - [x] CLI preview and dry-run - [x] unit/integration tests - [x] docs and usage examples - [x] e2e smoke on staging Notes: deterministic behavior is important to allow reproducible diffs between releases; the sampler uses a stable hash over manifest fields to seed sampling. The bundler includes an optional verbosity flag to expand snippets for full audit. Links: linear/ENG-2046, support/SUP-842. CI: unit tests were flaky for the stratified sampler on first run due to an off-by-one in boundary math; fixed in commit 3. This PR avoids changing the public onboarding contract but adds metadata fields to release bundles; existing consumers will ignore unknown fields.

review_comments: Ethan Park: Nice end-to-end flow, can you add a short note on how sampling interacts with existing prefix/KV caching policies?
Maya Chen: Answered - sampler returns a stable set of seed inputs; we annotate bundle metadata with recommended cache hints but do not mutate runtime cache behavior in this PR.
Priya Nair: The provenance hash should be stable across equivalent manifests; add a small fuzz test to assert invariants.
Maya Chen: Added tests asserting provenance stability for re-ordered manifest fields and for equivalent aliasing; pushed commit 4.
Riley Ford: CI showed a flaky stratified sampler test, observed an off-by-one causing one bucket to be empty at small sample sizes. Fix looks good.
Priya Nair: Approving pending a small docs tweak to explain coverage percentage semantics.
Ethan Park: Approving; left a nit about logging verbosity levels which can be a follow-up (ENG-2101).
merge_outcome: merged via squash merge by Maya Chen. Merge commit message: "Introduce cohorted intake sampler and release bundler (ENG-2046)". No conflicts. Backported changelog snippet generator to release/2025-09 for staging verification.
notes: This PR is intentionally conservative about contract changes: release bundles add new metadata keys (cohort_seed, provenance_hash, cohort_coverage) that are fully backward-compatible. The next follow-up PR will add optional sample-driven eval runners which will consume the bundles and produce per-cohort regression metrics (tracked in ENG-2101).
